data.content_ref: inline:Generalize the grounded extension to a family of fixpoints indexed by a total preorder on warrants, then define the accepted set as the intersection of all fixpoints that respect the preorder—skeptical over orders. The covering principle is that strengthening is choosing a coarser preorder, never changing the underlying attack graph. Because the family is finite and the intersection is computable by a polynomial number of grounded evaluations, determinism and polynomial cost are preserved. Reinstatement and committed-root validity follow from the intersection being a subset of each admissible fixpoint.
